newsitem.title: USA: Bedford Property names Whitney CFO.
newsitem.headline: Bedford Property names Whitney CFO.

text.p: Bedford Property Investors Inc, a real estate investment trust, Friday named Scott Whitney as its chief financial officer.
Whitney replaces Donald Lorenz, who resigned about two months ago, a company official said.
Whitney will report to Chief Executive Officer Peter Bedford, and he will be responsible for treasury, bank relations, accounting, human resources and investor relations.
Whitney, 45, had served as senior vice president/chief financial officer of WCI Communities of Naples, Fla. since 1995.
